title: 第1779章 龙女现世第1778章 第一天骄
slug: 纯阳霸体绝美师尊求与我修炼
content_zh:
玄黑色的流光撕裂白雾，苏铭犹如一颗坠落的陨石，直扑谷底深渊。
他这一动，原本还在崖壁上观望的各方世家势力，瞬间炸开了锅。
“有人动手了！”
“那是空源境兽王的幼崽！谁抢到就是谁的，绝不能落入他人之手！”
人为财死，鸟为食亡。
上百名曜源境和月源境的强者眼睛发红，各自施展身法，犹如一群闻到血腥味的秃鹫，铺天盖地地朝着深渊底部俯冲而去。
深渊中心，幽冥蟠龙虎刚刚完成分娩，庞大的身躯虚弱地趴在乱石堆中。
听到上空传来的密集破空声，这头空源境的兽王发出一声悲愤交加的怒吼。
它强撑起小山般的头颅，抬起布满暗紫鳞片的巨爪，带着撕裂虚空的罡风，朝着冲在最前面的苏铭狠狠拍下。
若是全盛时期，这一爪足以将十几个曜源境修士拍成肉泥。
但此刻的兽王已是强弩之末。
苏铭冷哼一声，脚下九阴神行的暗黑色气旋猛然加速。
他的身形在半空中划出一道诡异的折线，犹如穿花蝴蝶一般，险之又险地贴着巨爪的边缘掠过，连一片衣角都没有被罡风扫中。
越过兽王的阻碍，苏铭一把探出右手，稳稳地将乱石堆中那团散发着浓郁生机的紫色光团抓入怀中。
“得手了。”
苏铭心中微动，指尖运转阴阳源气，轻轻划开包裹在光团外层的粘稠胞衣，想要一睹这上古血脉幼崽的真容。
然而，当看清光团内部的景象时。
苏铭深邃的瞳孔骤然收缩，整个人罕见地愣在了原地。
光团里包裹的，根本不是什么虎头蛟尾的微型野兽。
而是一个白白胖胖、肌肤犹如羊脂玉般细腻的人形女婴！

女婴的额头两侧，生着一对精致的紫金龙角，身上没有半件衣物，周身流转着一层玄奥晦涩的远古符文。
“龙女？”
苏铭脑海中刚闪过这个念头。
一直紧闭双眼的女婴，突然睁开了眼眸。
那是一双淡金色的竖瞳，没有初生婴儿的懵懂与纯真，只有一种俯瞰万古、视苍生为草芥的无上威严。
这等眼神，苏铭只在那些常年身居高位的女帝身上见过。
两人视线交汇的刹那。
女婴淡金色的竖瞳中迸发出一道实质化的神魂利剑。
嗡！
苏铭只觉得识海内轰然炸响，仿佛有一柄万钧重锤狠狠敲击在灵魂深处。
即便是以他如今坚韧无比的心境，在这股太古级别的意志冲击下，意识也不由自主地陷入了长达一秒的空白。
借着苏铭短暂眩晕的这一秒空档。
女婴周身的紫色符文光芒大盛，整个人化作一团璀璨夺目的紫日，直接挣脱了苏铭的怀抱，犹如一道流星冲天而起，直奔九玄山脉的更深处飞去。
content_en:
The black stream of light tore through the white mist, and Su Ming was like a falling meteorite, plunging straight into the abyss at the bottom of the valley.
With his movement, the forces of various aristocratic families who were still watching on the cliff instantly exploded.
"Someone took action!"
"That's the cub of the Kongyuan Realm Beast King! Whoever grabs it belongs to him, and it must not fall into the hands of others!"
Man dies for wealth, and bird dies for food.
The eyes of hundreds of strong men from the Yaoyuan Realm and the Moon Origin Realm were red, and they each used their own movements, like a group of vultures smelling the smell of blood, swooping toward the bottom of the abyss.
In the center of the abyss, Nether Dragon and Tiger had just finished giving birth, and their huge body lay weakly among the rocks.
Hearing the dense sound of breaking through the air from above, the beast king of the Kongyuan Realm let out a roar of grief and anger.
It forced its hill-like head up, raised its giant claws covered with dark purple scales, and with the strong wind tearing through the void, it struck hard at Su Ming, who was rushing at the front.
In its heyday, this claw would have been enough to beat a dozen Yaoyuan realm monks into a pulp.
But at this moment, the Beast King is at the end of his strength.
Su Ming snorted coldly, and the dark black cyclone of Jiuyin Shenxing under his feet suddenly accelerated.
His figure drew a strange fold line in mid-air, like a butterfly passing through a flower, passing dangerously close to the edge of the giant claw, without even a corner of his clothes being swept away by the strong wind.
Overcoming the obstruction of the Beast King, Su Ming reached out his right hand and firmly grasped the purple light group that exuded rich vitality in the pile of rocks into his arms.
"Succeeded."
Su Ming's heart moved slightly, and he circulated the yin and yang source energy with his fingertips, gently slicing open the sticky outer layer of the light mass, wanting to see the true appearance of this ancient bloodline cub.
However, when the scene inside the light group is clearly seen.
Su Ming's deep pupils suddenly shrank, and his whole person was stunned in a rare moment.
What was wrapped in the ball of light was not a miniature beast with the head of a tiger and the tail of a dragon.
Instead, it was a humanoid baby girl who was fair and plump, with skin as delicate as mutton-fat jade!
On both sides of the baby girl's forehead, there are a pair of exquisite purple-gold dragon horns. She has no clothes on her body, and there is a layer of mysterious and obscure ancient runes flowing around her body.
"Dragon girl?"
This thought just flashed through Su Ming's mind.
The baby girl, who had been keeping her eyes closed, suddenly opened them.
Those are a pair of pale golden vertical pupils, without the ignorance and innocence of a newborn baby, only a kind of supreme majesty that overlooks the eternity and regards the common people as nothing.
Su Ming had only seen this kind of look on empresses who had been in high positions all year round.
The moment their eyes met.
A materialized divine soul sword burst out from the baby girl's pale golden vertical pupils.
Buzz!
Su Ming felt a loud explosion in his consciousness, as if a huge hammer was hitting the depths of his soul.
Even with his current extremely tenacious state of mind, under the impact of this ancient level of will, his consciousness could not help but fall into a blank for a second.
Taking advantage of the moment when Su Ming was briefly dizzy.
The purple runes around the baby girl's body glowed brightly, and the whole body turned into a dazzling purple sun. She broke away from Su Ming's arms and flew straight into the sky like a meteor, flying deeper into the Jiuxuan Mountains.
